observations.title: Define a weapon innate skill through supported data
observations.player_action: A pack developer uses the library's skill JSON format for animations, icons, stack size and configured command effects.
observations.outcome: A dependent weapon can expose a custom innate without rebuilding every shared component.
conditions: Do not import a demo JSON from a different Epic Fight branch as a 20.14.8.2-compatible contract.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Invincible's name is not a promise of player invulnerability. The consuming addon/data defines the actual ability, cost and result; use that owner's execution signal.

observations.title: Define a conditional key-combination move
observations.player_action: A developer uses supported combo data/code with key combinations and conditions.
observations.outcome: Weapons can choose different combo branches; the library also exposes afterimage/ground-slam presentation facilities.
conditions: The actual combo belongs to its consuming addon; no generic library item acquisition is implied.
